prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: parking lot collision in Pearland, Texas. The claimant was a passenger and reported wrist fracture. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1141; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Officers responded to a report of a two-vehicle collision in a commercial parking lot in Pearland, Texas. On arrival, Driver 1 and Driver 2 were standing beside their vehicles, and both stated that the collision occurred as described when one vehicle backed out of a parking space and struck the side of the other. Several bystanders who saw the impact gave consistent accounts, and a witness pointed out the position of the vehicles before they were moved. Photographs taken at the scene show damage to the rear quarter panel of the vehicle driven by Driver 1, and the location and pattern of the damage match the impact described by all parties. No earlier damage to either vehicle was reported or observed. Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle, and both the responding officers and the witnesses confirmed Passenger's presence at the time of the collision. Passenger reported pain in the wrist and was transported for evaluation. Officers note that it is not yet clear whether the wrist injury resulted from this collision. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the vehicle, and the documents presented at the scene were reviewed.
